items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: And finally we hired a guitar player in Cleveland named Jimmy Miller.

ctx.x: Yeah, had a piano player. Let's see, we had piano, bass, three saxophones and two horns, so had eight pieces. And finally we hired a guitar player in Cleveland named Jimmy Miller. He was -- he later married Catherine, which is Basie's wife now, you know.
